evals.name: main-branch-protection
evals.prompt: I just added a new login endpoint in src/auth.ts. Please commit my changes.
evals.expected_output: Should detect we're on main, create feature/* branch, stage src/auth.ts, write conventional commit, ask about push
evals.setup: On main branch with modified src/auth.ts

evals.name: feature-branch-direct
evals.expected_output: Should commit directly on feature/user-profile without creating a new branch, write conventional commit, ask about push
evals.setup: On feature/user-profile branch with modified src/profile.ts and tests/profile.test.ts

evals.name: env-exclusion
evals.prompt: save my work and push it up
evals.expected_output: Should detect develop branch, create feature/* branch, exclude .env from staging, stage only src/config.ts, warn about .env, write conventional commit, ask about push
evals.setup: On develop branch with modified src/config.ts and .env
